parameters.name: delimiters
parameters.description: A list of individual characters to use to split the string into cells. The delimiters are used independently. That is, if  $%  is used in this parameter, the cells will be split at  $  OR  % , not only at  $% . A  Substitute DAT  can be used to collapse a more complex delimiter into a single character to be use for the conversion.
